governance_bootstrap.description: Current repair gate: permit only hash-lineage-selected first-report/history, projection, strict station-contract ordering, business-artifact semantics, frontend runtime-hash identity, runtime-callable authority, current-state attention projection, and the sealed deployment controller used by the runtime-verification pilot. Registry membership and all unrelated runtime changes remain fail-closed.

baseline_history_gate.description: Exact H2 repair scope for first-report baseline semantics. Only the Signal/Agent history facade and the two artifact station boundaries may change; Agent1 runtime, identity binding and downstream action stages remain sealed.

first_report_projection_repair.description: Exact scope for first-report canonical baseline evidence plus operator-center product-count projection. A direct pipeline-live to canonical-product-snapshot IMPORTS edge is allowed; no Agent/Signal worker, Registry membership or external-interface change is allowed.

active_dataversion_projection_gate.description: Exact current-run projection gate. The compatibility facade may read imported_report_rows to resolve the active dataVersion; when none exists it must project zero current products/Signals/Agents while preserving canonical history. No Agent worker, Signal generation, Registry membership or external-interface change is allowed.

current_state_attention_projection.description: Unified-Registry/Hash-Lineage scoped repair for operator-center attention. dataVersion+storeId+productId defines current identity; the newest row must be selected before observed/action filtering so observed_soft_gate can never expose an older Agent1 state. Only the active pipeline-live facade may change in production Runtime; Signal Admission and Agent workers remain sealed.

baseline_artifact_contract_ordering.description: Exact strict-contract ordering repair. Business station outputs are validated before station_queue persists immutable ART transport references. Only station_contract_service may change; no Runtime membership, Registry membership, graph edge, Signal/Agent worker or external-interface change is allowed.

baseline_signal_field_semantics.description: Field-registry anchored semantic repair. Only station_business_artifact_service may change inside production Runtime; governance overlay, checker and tests are proof-only. Canonical V23 Registry roots remain sealed and Signal/Agent workers stay untouched.

frontend_runtime_hash_invalidation.description: Field-registry anchored frontend cache repair. dataVersion remains data identity, runtimeStateHash becomes mutable execution identity, and immutable module/manifest Artifacts remain content-addressed. Only the frontend materializer and hash-view client may change in production Runtime.

runtime_callable_authority.description: Eliminate import-time authority split. The hard-interface bridge may decorate private producer hooks but may not replace public Station callables or their version ownership; the Station truth binder is verification-only and may not mutate DEFAULT_OUTPUTS.

runtime_verification_pilot.description: Competition-only pilot profile. Only the sealed deployment controller may change Runtime behavior; the verifier/config probes remain under config/**/* and do not change runtime membership.

agent1_recovery.description: Reserved H2 profile. Keep fail-closed until the recovery scope artifact names the exact Agent1 runtime paths/modules/nodes that still require behavioral repair.

scoped_runtime_change.description: Fail-closed template for a future graph-scoped runtime update. Populate explicit runtime path/module/node allowlists before use.
